title: storage/remote: fix typo in NHCB drop log message
body:
The warning logged when a native histogram with custom buckets (NHCB) is dropped because remote write v1 does not support it ended with "does not support itB". Drop the stray trailing "B".

This affects both the integer and float histogram paths. Introduced in #17146.
